members.name: routing_v10b_a
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which specific issue is the customer writing about? Pick the option that best matches the main request.

criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment or charge the customer says they did not make or do not recognise (unknown merchant, purchase they never made), even if they ask for a refund or dispute
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal shown on the account or in the app that the customer did not make, does not recognise, or never received (e.g. 'non-received cash in my app')
criteria.direct_debit_not_recognised: Any problem with a debit transaction or direct debit: one the customer did not set up or does not recognise, or wanting to dispute, cancel, refund or reverse a debit transaction / direct debit
criteria.unknown_money_received: Money appeared in the account that the customer did not put there, or cash is missing from the account
criteria.compromised_card: Customer thinks their card details were stolen, hacked or compromised, or someone else is using their card/account; wants to freeze the card or account
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Customer lost their card or it was stolen and needs to report or block it (including asking for a replacement)
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Customer lost their phone or it was stolen, worried about access to the app
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM kept / swallowed / took the customer's card
criteria.pin_blocked_or_forgotten: Card PIN is blocked after too many wrong attempts, the PIN is rejected, or the customer wants to unblock or reset their PIN
criteria.change_pin: How or where to change the card PIN (e.g. which ATMs let me change my PIN)
criteria.passcode_or_login: Forgotten app passcode or password, can't log in to the app with the passcode, locked out, passcode error
criteria.request_refund: Customer wants a refund from a merchant or for a purchase, wants to cancel an order or purchase, how to get money back for something bought, or how to dispute a purchase they made
criteria.refund_not_showing: A refund the customer was promised has not appeared on the statement or account
criteria.charged_twice: The same payment was charged twice / duplicated / multiple times
criteria.wrong_cash_amount: At the ATM the customer was using: it gave the wrong amount of cash (less or more than requested), the customer could not get the cash they wanted, or no cash came out but the account was debited
criteria.reverted_or_cancelled_payment: A card payment was reverted, returned, cancelled or terminated and the customer wants to know why
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An unexplained extra charge, fee or small amount (e.g. a £1 / 1 pound / $1 charge) on the statement that the customer wants explained, even if they say they bought nothing of that amount
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_purchase: The customer complains that an exchange rate applied to them was wrong, too high or not what they expected (e.g. on a card purchase abroad or in a foreign currency)
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_atm: Getting cash from an ATM abroad, in another country or in a foreign currency: the exchange rate or amount charged was wrong, or any question about the exchange rates or extra fees for getting / withdrawing cash
criteria.exchange_charge_complaint: Complaint that a specific currency exchange the customer made cost too much or that the exchange charges applied were wrong
criteria.exchange_fee_question: General question about whether currency exchange is free, what the bank charges for exchanging currency, or exchange fees
criteria.activate_card: How to activate a new card
criteria.card_arrival: Customer's new card has not arrived yet / tracking the card delivery
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes, delivery dates or delivery to a particular country
criteria.card_linking: Linking or adding a card to the app, making the card show up in the app, reactivating a card that was found after being reported lost
criteria.card_not_working: Card stopped working or doesn't work (no specific transaction)
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted, which ATMs or shops can be used with the card
criteria.spare_or_additional_card: Getting a second, spare or additional physical card
criteria.virtual_card: Getting a virtual card, or a virtual card not working / rejected
criteria.disposable_card: Disposable virtual cards: limits, how many, how many uses
criteria.order_physical_card: Ordering a new physical card, card fees or express delivery fees for a card
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Any question mentioning Visa or Mastercard, or about choosing which card the customer gets: whether the bank accepts or issues Visa or Mastercard, which one the card is, choosing one or wanting the other
criteria.card_expiring: Card about to expire or expired, getting a replacement for expiry
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment in a shop or online was declined / rejected
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment is still showing as pending
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: The ATM declined the cash withdrawal / wouldn't let me take out cash
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal the customer made at an ATM is still pending, not yet reflected, or the balance after the withdrawal is not what they expected
criteria.apple_google_pay: Anything involving Apple Pay, Google Pay or a phone/watch wallet: using it, setting it up, topping up through it (even if failing), or which cards or currencies it accepts
criteria.get_first_pin: Customer does not know, cannot find or has not received their card PIN: where to find the PIN, how the PIN is sent, how to set the PIN on a new card
criteria.top_up_by_card: The steps for topping up the account with a card the customer already knows is accepted
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed, was declined, or money vanished / disappeared from the account without the customer describing an unauthorised transaction
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up was reverted or cancelled
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is pending or the topped-up money hasn't shown up yet
criteria.top_up_cash_cheque: Topping up with cash or a cheque, where to deposit cash
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer: Topping up by bank transfer, how top-ups work in general, where the top-up option is
criteria.transfer_not_received: A transfer the customer sent has not arrived at the recipient / beneficiary
criteria.pending_transfer: A transfer is still pending or taking long
criteria.failed_or_declined_transfer: A transfer failed or was declined
criteria.cancel_transfer: Cancelling a transfer or a transaction the customer made (when it is not about a purchase or order from a merchant)
criteria.transfer_into_account: Transferring money into the account from another bank account or with a card
criteria.transfer_timing: How long transfers take to arrive
criteria.receiving_money: Receiving money / salary from someone, how to get paid into the account, missing incoming transfer
criteria.balance_not_updated_transfer: Balance has not updated after a bank transfer, or a payment/transfer can't be found
criteria.balance_not_updated_deposit: Balance has not updated after a cheque or cash deposit
criteria.sending_money: How to send money or make a transfer, SWIFT, transfer to the wrong account and wanting it fixed
criteria.card_payment_fee: A fee charged on a card payment
criteria.atm_fee: A fee charged for an ordinary ATM cash withdrawal at home, or whether withdrawals cost anything (not withdrawals abroad / in another country or currency)
criteria.transfer_fee: A fee charged on a transfer, whether sending or receiving money costs anything / is charged, or the recipient received less money than was sent
criteria.top_up_card_fee: A fee charged for topping up by card
criteria.top_up_bank_transfer_fee: A fee charged for topping up by bank transfer
criteria.exchange_rate: General questions about the exchange rates the bank uses for exchanging currency or paying (what they are, how they are set); not complaints that a rate applied was wrong, and not rates for getting cash
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange currency in the app
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which currencies can be held or exchanged
criteria.supported_cards_currencies: Which types of card or currency can be used to top up (including topping up with other cards): whether the bank accepts the customer's credit card, American Express, US cards or other card types (when Visa or Mastercard is not named), or what is not accepted for top-ups
criteria.verify_identity: How to verify identity, what documents are needed for the identity check
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: The identity verification is failing or not working, or the app says it cannot recognise or verify that the customer is who they say they are
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why the bank needs to verify the customer's identity
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Proving the source of funds / where my money comes from
criteria.money_origin: Asking where some money in the account came from (without saying it is fraudulent)
criteria.age_limit: Age requirements for opening an account
criteria.country_support: Which countries the bank operates in or supports for customers, whether people living in a given country can sign up or get a card, or whether the customer can use the service all over the world
criteria.verify_top_up: Top-up verification codes, why a top-up needs verification, verifying the top-up card
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Customer cannot or is not allowed to send money to a particular account or beneficiary: 'why can't I transfer to this account', blocked beneficiary, transfer not possible, transfer to a crypto exchange or buying crypto not going through
criteria.card_not_allowed: Card is not allowed / restricted for a purchase without a decline reason given
